thread:
lisa.eng: Heads-up — I opened a slim PR to consolidate the function-calling examples and a compact structured-output sample. A few goals: 1) reduce duplication across SDK snippets, 2) show a tiny JSON-schema + fallback parsing pattern, 3) fix two dead links in the tool-calling guide. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3421 :eyes:

matt.docs: Nice. Can you paste the compact example here so reviewers can sanity-check before the CI runs? Trying to keep these examples short for the quickstart page.

lisa.eng: Sure — here's the sample I want in the SDK snippets section. It demonstrates a single-tool call, schema validation, and a simple parse fallback. Keeps to ~8 lines.

lisa.eng: ```json
{
  "tool": "weather_lookup",
  "input": {"city": "Seattle"},
  "expected_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"temp":{"type":"number"},"units":{"type":"string"}},"required":["temp"]}
}
```

anna.reviewer: Looks good overall. Two nits: call name should be weather.get and the schema property "units" should allow nulls (some tools omit it). Also add one short sentence describing the fallback (parse raw text -> regex -> schema).

lisa.eng: Good catches — updated the snippet in the PR and added the fallback explanation. New snippet uses weather.get and units: ["string","null"].

sam.platform: For Dedicated runtimes, can we note that the example assumes streaming is off? Otherwise the schema parse step needs to handle partial chunks. Maybe a one-liner comment is enough.

lisa.eng: Added a parenthetical note: "(assumes non-streaming response)". Also fixed two links: /guides/tool-calling -> /docs/tool-calling and a dead anchor in /docs/structured-output#best-practices. doc-bot: link-checker run started.

doc-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining. CI: docs-lint passed, snippets-compact build passed.

matt.docs: Awesome. Can anna or sam approve when you have a minute so we can merge before the next release train? I'm going to include the compact snippet in the quickstart patch if approved.

anna.reviewer: Approving now. Small follow-up: can we add a single-line comment in the snippet showing the regex fallback example? Something like: `// fallback: extract \"temp: ([0-9.]+)\"`

lisa.eng: Done. Pushed. Thanks all. I'll merge after changelog entry.

sam.platform: Thx — leaving a note in the Dedicated runbook to remind integrators about streaming caveat.

lisa.eng: Merged and cherrypicked to stable branch. Closing thread. :tada:
